verdict.rationale: Fastmail is an email SaaS, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence documents only the JMAP API, API tokens and OAuth. Those are developer building blocks an agent integration could be built on, not an official MCP server, and nothing in the pack mentions MCP.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
